one_line: HuggingFace dataset (BrightData, last modified 2025-05-12, licence tag 'other' = bright-data-master-service-agreement): a single public CSV booking-listings.csv of 62,784,719 bytes (~63 MB, HF size category 10K<n<100K rows) — NOT the 13-row marketing sample the scout assumed. 35 columns of Booking.com search-result listings for Feb-2025 check-in dates, global (first rows are Korea): url, location, check_in, check_out, adults/children/rooms, id, title, address, city, review_score, review_count, final_price, original_price, currency, tax_description, nb_bedrooms/nb_all_beds/nb_kitchens/nb_livingrooms, no_prepayment, free_cancellation, free_cancellation_until, property_sustainability, country, hotel_rank, searched_country, map_coordinates, listing_country, total_listings_found, star_rating, tags.
abnb_use: Three gaps at once: quoted prices with original_price vs final_price on a competitor platform for a fixed Feb-2025 stay date (gap 9, competitor pricing / alternative accommodation); the no_prepayment, free_cancellation and free_cancellation_until flags are a direct read on how widely 'reserve now, pay later' terms are offered on Booking.com, which is the competitive backdrop to our RNPL thesis (gap 3); nb_bedrooms/nb_all_beds gives a party-size/whole-unit capacity distribution outside Airbnb (gap 20), plus a rough regional (searched_country/listing_country) split.
sample_plan: Range-read the head only, never the whole 63 MB file: curl -sL -r 0-5000000 -o brightdata_booking_listings_head.csv 'https://huggingface.co/datasets/BrightData/Booking.com-Listings/resolve/main/booking-listings.csv' (~5 MB, drop the final truncated line). No login or token needed (verified: HTTP 200, content-type text/csv). Record row count, distinct searched_country, the free_cancellation / no_prepayment shares and the final_price distribution from the head; do not redistribute the file, and do not fetch the remaining ~58 MB without a human licence decision.
